description: This file defines the Feed controller class for the OpenCart admin extension system. It manages listing, installation, uninstallation, and validation of feed extensions within the admin area.

classes.name: Feed
classes.description: Controller class for managing feed extensions in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing available feeds, and handling install/uninstall operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Outputs the list of feed extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a list of available and installed feed extensions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to modify feed extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a specified feed extension.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the removal of a specified feed extension.
